content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required prior authorization was missing, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Resubmission or records alone would not cure the authorization denial, while a formal appeal is still available and is the only payer-directed action with any success among similar claims. Patient billing is premature because the appeal path has not been exhausted.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
